title: Meetings in Berlin, London and Hanover
html:
Daniel-Constantin Mierla, co-founder Kamailio SIP Server project, will be visiting several VoIP-related events in the next weeks, if you want to meet and discuss about latest news and achievements of our project, write an email to <miconda [at] gmail.com>.

You can meet him in:

  • Berlin, during Call Center World 2012, Feb 27 – March 01
  • London, during UC Expo 2012, March 06-07
  • Hanover, during Cebit 2012, March 08-10

Looking forward to meeting many of you very soon!
